notes.title: Update 1.1. (early access)
notes.content:
- Added the "Tracks" window.

How to use it:

1. Drag the sound to the button.
2. Click on the red circle.
3. Play the melody, and stop the recording.
4. Move the blocks if they sound early or remove extra by pressing "Del"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32609321/519af53410cf3273dae25739e154425d2a26332a.gif[/img]
